rationale: Every run's worst path touches an I/O port at ss 100C max-RC while reg-to-reg has slack. The AREA3/TD/post-GRT-timing/cap213 family fits T_eff ~ 11.66 + 0.105*T (+/-0.04) across util 30-44, margins and ABC options, so the port cone looks logic/latency-limited; tighter targets gain only via I/O-delay scaling (self-consistent period ~13 ns). Hold, DRC and slew/cap (4 vs 3053) have ample headroom. Setting 1 copies r1-001 but swaps in DELAY 4 to test whether faster synthesized logic shortens the port cone (des's poor DELAY 4 run had TD off). Setting 2 keeps AREA 3 but shrinks the die (util 45), tightens slew/cap repair for sharper long-wire edges, and targets 8.64 ns.
